items.item_text: Graduation from an AMA accredited Vascular Lab Training Program as well as certification or board eligible by a nationally recognized Vascular Technology Registry. and, upon hire and
Basic Life Support - CPR, upon hire and (Must be through the American Heart Association)
1 year acute care experience, upon hire

Receives patients and explains Vascular Lab procedures in order to obtain cooperation and allay anxieties during performance of procedure; continually assesses the immediate needs and conditions of assigned patients. Performs non-invasive vascular procedures in accordance with department protocols and guidelines. Checks the quality of images/scans in general and is responsible for the data and quality control of work performed.

Communicates preliminary findings and/or reading physician's written interpretation of tests, when indicated, to designated staff and referring Physician Offices. Assists in scheduling patients for vascular examinations and keeps front office personnel notified about changes that impact the daily schedule.
Maintains work areas in clean and orderly condition and ensures that examination areas are properly supplied, equipped and operational before each examination.
Registered Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist, upon hire or
Registered Cardiac Electr, upon hire or
Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer, upon hire or
Registered Technologist Radiography ARRT, upon hire
